about: Max's rehearsal set (Nov 4, 2026): 40 calls run through the real prompt and model by rehearse() in voice.js. tools/maxrehearse.mjs queues them and reads the results. Callers are written the way speech-to-text hands them over: run-on, lowercase, a few slips. Every business and person here is made up.
